subject.title: feat: let plugin tools yield turns

question: Should OpenClaw make `yieldToolResult(...)` plus `canYield: true` a supported permanent Plugin SDK contract for plugin-owned asynchronous interaction handoffs?
rationale: The patch is intentionally additive and has focused runtime proof, but a public SDK control changes the supported extension contract and its long-term compatibility obligations; that acceptance cannot be inferred from tests alone.

options.title: Adopt the narrow yield contract
options.body: Accept the opt-in result-level handoff because it reuses the existing session-yield lifecycle without adding channel-specific state or policy to core.

options.title: Require a different SDK boundary
options.body: Pause the PR and define a different public extension contract if maintainers do not want plugin tools to request runtime turn control through results.

recommendation.title: Adopt the narrow yield contract
recommendation.body: Accept the opt-in result-level handoff because it reuses the existing session-yield lifecycle without adding channel-specific state or policy to core.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied discussion connects jriff to the existing `sessions_yield` lifecycle that forms the semantic basis of this public contract.
